phase_sequence.name: contact
phase_sequence.note: front foot contacts ground, back foot pushes off
phase_sequence.anatomy: LEFT/ORANGE leg reaches forward with heel contacting; RIGHT/GREEN leg extends behind on toes; RIGHT/BLUE arm swings forward and LEFT/RED arm swings back

phase_sequence.name: down
phase_sequence.anatomy: LEFT/ORANGE leg is the bent planted support under the pelvis; RIGHT/GREEN toes leave the ground behind; arms retain the same cross-lateral direction

phase_sequence.name: passing
phase_sequence.anatomy: LEFT/ORANGE leg is nearly vertical and planted; RIGHT/GREEN bent foot passes low beneath the pelvis; both arms pass close to neutral

phase_sequence.name: up
phase_sequence.note: body lifts before the opposite contact
phase_sequence.anatomy: LEFT/ORANGE leg extends behind on toes; RIGHT/GREEN knee swings only slightly forward with the foot low; LEFT/RED arm is forward and RIGHT/BLUE arm is back

phase_sequence.name: opposite_contact
phase_sequence.anatomy: RIGHT/GREEN leg reaches forward with heel contacting; LEFT/ORANGE leg extends behind on toes; LEFT/RED arm swings forward and RIGHT/BLUE arm swings back

phase_sequence.name: opposite_down
phase_sequence.note: weight drops over the opposite planted foot
phase_sequence.anatomy: RIGHT/GREEN leg is the bent planted support under the pelvis; LEFT/ORANGE toes leave the ground behind; arms retain the same cross-lateral direction

phase_sequence.name: opposite_passing
phase_sequence.anatomy: RIGHT/GREEN leg is nearly vertical and planted; LEFT/ORANGE bent foot passes low beneath the pelvis; both arms pass close to neutral

phase_sequence.name: opposite_up
phase_sequence.anatomy: RIGHT/GREEN leg extends behind on toes; LEFT/ORANGE knee swings only slightly forward with the foot low; RIGHT/BLUE arm is forward and LEFT/RED arm is back
